validator.message: Enter at least one sample element.

param.name: run_name
param.label: Run name
param.help: Defaults to the diffraction dataset name.

tool.help: Runs the existing RADAR-PD scientific pipeline inside an ephemeral Galaxy job. Direct Galaxy history input is the default and does not require an IPTS. The optional IPTS route resolves one unambiguous reduced pattern and matching instrument profile from a read-only SNS mount. Every GPX checkpoint produced by Full or Rapid mode is returned as a collection, along with plots, tables, phase CIFs, a normalized machine-readable summary, and a complete results archive.
